mapper.insert: insert into trade_event_consume_record ( event_id, order_id, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, routing_key, consume_count, consume_status, last_error, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventId}, #{orderId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{eventType}, #{routingKey}, #{consumeCount}, #{consumeStatus}, #{lastError}, #{createTime}, now() ) on duplicate key update event_id = event_id
mapper.select: select id, event_id, order_id, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, routing_key, consume_count, consume_status, last_error, create_time, update_time from trade_event_consume_record where event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: update trade_event_consume_record set consume_status = 4, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and ( consume_status in (0, 2) or (consume_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) )
update trade_event_consume_record set consume_count = consume_count + 1, consume_status = 1, last_error = null, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status = 4
update trade_event_consume_record set consume_count = consume_count + 1, consume_status = 2, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status = 4
update trade_event_consume_record set consume_count = consume_count + 1, consume_status = 3, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and consume_status in (0, 2, 4)
